blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said she is planning to sell properties to pay the P5 million she owed to her friends and to cover expenses of her impeachment trial and the case of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, in the International Criminal Court (ICC).
